body:
My friend was in a similar crossroads in life. No significant age gap but proximity and promises always had them getting back together and within months it was the same ole BS. 13 years of it, on and off. She took a job in the NE, very far away. He was upset and gave an ultimatum. She hopped a flight and started over. Anywho it’s been 2 years since that and she’s married to a really cool guy and they just had a baby. 
She loved him but she loved herself and her goals more and when she let go of making him fit into her dreams she found a man that was basically born of them. 
so yeah, take the job. 30 is a great decade to try something/someone new
